title: Sticky header that actually sticks
why_it_matters: A header that disappears on scroll is annoying on long mobile pages.
explanation: position: sticky with a top value keeps an element visible once you scroll to it. Give it a background, or content will show through. If it fails, check the ancestors: overflow: hidden on a parent breaks it.
try_it: Add overflow: hidden to the parent and watch the header stop sticking.
